name: Rename the element type to lantern:::ui:::Element
body:
Dean, 2026-10-30 (decision card): the game's UI components return Ui:::Element instead of Lantern:::Component. Possible once Ui::: (the old immediate-mode API) is removed.

Dean, 2026-10-30 (thread): the name should say where the element comes from, so game elements and Penumbra:::Component never read alike. Lantern's names all start with Lantern:::, and Lantern names no other engine. So the element type is lantern:::ui:::Element.

Dean, 2026-10-30 (thread): namespace names are lowercase; Element stays PascalCase because it is a type. So lantern:::ui:::Element.

comments.text: Filed before starting, per Dean's standing rule.
Renamed from Ui:::Element after Dean's naming message.
Done. Tests pass; the running game was checked under Xvfb (hovering Quit focuses it, clicking Play starts the game).

plan:
- The bridge registers the element type as lantern::ui::Element (Nyx accepts the three-part name).
- Rename in games/platformer/ui/*.chaos, the chaos-ui tests, game_ui.rs's docs, docs/game-api.md and D-043/D-044.
- Regenerate the host surface manifest.
